claims.source_quote_ar: (من) اسم استفهام مبني في محلّ جر متعلق بمحذوف خبر مقدم
claims.claim_ar: استخدام أداة الاستفهام «مَن» بصيغة إنشائية لاستدراكٍ وتحدٍّ لِمَنْ يدّعي أن الله لم يَنزِل على بشر
claims.claim_en: Use of the interrogative 'mān' as a constructive/rhetorical question that challenges the claim that God did not send revelation to any human.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source is a grammatical/exegetical note identifying '(من)' as an interrogative; the rhetorical reading (challenge/constructive interrogation) is an interpretive inference rather than an explicit label in the chunk.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Turns an asserted denial into a pointed challenge that shifts burden of proof onto the claimants and provokes reflection.
